request: Implement remaining compatible Overworld features in stages; add no Nether/End-related blocks, items, creatures, structures or progression. Keep existing worlds and custom content.
notes: Registry entries are exact reference names; a deferred technical state can have a working custom counterpart (wheat/carrots/potatoes, bubble columns, maps, pigs/sheep and disc playback).
This backlog does not claim every existing item is Survival-obtainable or mechanically exact. See CONTENT.md and AQUATIC.md.
Existing Nether-derived and Cinderworld content is retained. No new Nether/End entries are introduced in this stage.
The source asset audit and the missing creature/enchantment lists are separate from complete gameplay-system parity.
